README.md.name: README.md
README.md.content:
# strucit

A platform for structured content creation and management.
Current version: 2.3.1

## Stack
- Frontend: React + TypeScript
- Backend: Node.js + Postgres
- Infra: Vercel + Supabase

## Status
Live at: https://strucit.app

## Quick start
```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

## Endpoints
  GET  /api/status      — system health
  GET  /api/projects    — list projects
  POST /api/projects    — create project

See also: manifest.json

README.md.content:
# The Dram Club

Guided whisky tasting app for enthusiasts and clubs.
Record noses, palates, finishes. Offline-first. Syncs when you're ready.

## Stack
- Web: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 (PWA)
- Mobile: Expo 54 / React Native 0.81
- Marketing: Astro 6
- API: Cloudflare Pages Functions
- DB: PostgreSQL + Drizzle ORM (UUID v7)
- Auth: Clerk
- i18n: EN + PT-BR
- Deploy: Cloudflare Pages

## Features
- Personal whisky library
- Detailed tasting profiles (aroma, palate, finish, harmonization)
- Offline-first with background cloud sync
- Installable PWA + native mobile app

## Status
Live at: https://dramclub.app

See also: manifest.json

README.md.name: README.md
README.md.content:
# That Should Be an Email

Browser extension that calculates the real-time cost of meetings
and nudges you to send an email instead.

Works on Google Calendar and Microsoft 365 Outlook.

## How it works
1. Scrapes attendee list and duration from the browser DOM.
2. Cross-references roles against a local salary database.
3. Computes cost: sum(Rate_i × Duration/60) for all attendees.
4. If cost exceeds threshold: suggests an email alternative.

## Stack
- Browser Extension: Chrome + Edge (Manifest V3)
- Salary DB: CSV → built JS module
- Website: Astro

## Status
Live at: https://thatshouldbeanemail.com
Extension v1.4.1

## Note
The real cost of this README is approximately $0.00.
Meetings are less lucky.

See also: manifest.json

README.md.name: README.md
README.md.content:
# firelin-terminal

A retro CRT terminal web component. The one you are using right now.
Built as an Easter egg for my personal site.

Activate with: ↑↑↓↓←→←→BA  (Konami Code)

## Stack
- Vanilla JS
- Web Components (Shadow DOM)
- Webpack 5 + Babel
- CSS custom properties (theming)

## Features
- Virtual filesystem (VFS) with UNIX-like permissions
- 20+ commands
- Command history
- Tab completion
- Syntax highlighting
- Persistent session (localStorage)
- Scramble text effect

## Status
Embedded at: https://fogol.in

## Meta
You found the project that is the terminal inside the terminal.
Congratuations. This is turtles all the way down.

diary.txt.name: diary.txt
diary.txt.content:
Day 1
Started building the terminal. "It'll be quick," I said.

Day 8
The VFS took three rewrites. The parser ate two weekends.
"It's an Easter egg," I said. "Nobody will go this deep."

Day 14
Added lore to the logs. Coffee machine daemon has more personality than most
SaaS products I've used.

Day 21
You're reading this. You went deep.
I respect that.

Since you're here — check out /projects. Real stuff lives there.
And if you find any bugs, it's a feature.

— Lucas Fogolin
